title: Limits, ethics and writing it up
summary: Know what GCAM transport cannot see, weigh whose future and whose cost your scenarios assume, describe GCAM properly in a paper, report in IAMC format, and publish a reproducible package.
outcomes: List what GCAM transport cannot see, and how to state those limits
Identify equity and ethical choices hidden in scenario assumptions
Describe your GCAM version and changes following the community guidelines
Report results in IAMC variables and publish a package that rebuilds every figure
narration_en: Every model has blind spots, and a good study names them. GCAM transport does not track the vehicle fleet, has limited behavioural detail, treats aviation and shipping fuels as one pool of liquids, and has no explicit infrastructure such as charging networks. Say so, and say how each limit could bias your answer. Scenarios also carry ethical choices: whose travel grows, who pays for the transition, and whether results rely on carbon removal later in the century. Make those choices visible. When you write up, follow the GCAM community guidelines: state the exact version, every change you made to inputs and code, and where to find them. Report results using standard variable names from the Integrated Assessment Modeling Consortium, so others can compare them with other models. Finally, publish a reproducible package: the GCAM version, your add-on files, configuration and batch files, queries, analysis scripts and a short readme. If someone else cannot rebuild your figures, the study is not finished.
narration_ar: لكل نموذج نقاط عمياء، والدراسة الجيدة تسمّيها. فقطاع النقل في GCAM لا يتتبع أسطول المركبات، وتفاصيله السلوكية محدودة، ويعامل وقود الطيران والشحن البحري كمخزون واحد من الوقود السائل، ولا يمثل البنية التحتية صراحةً مثل شبكات الشحن. اذكر ذلك، واذكر كيف يمكن لكل قيد أن يُحيز إجابتك. وتحمل السيناريوهات أيضًا خيارات أخلاقية: سفرُ مَن ينمو، ومَن يدفع تكلفة التحول، وهل تعتمد النتائج على إزالة الكربون في أواخر القرن. اجعل هذه الخيارات ظاهرة. وعند الكتابة، اتبع إرشادات مجتمع GCAM: اذكر الإصدار بدقة، وكل تغيير أجريته على المدخلات والشيفرة، ومكان العثور عليه. واعرض النتائج بأسماء المتغيرات القياسية لاتحاد نمذجة التقييم المتكامل، حتى يتمكن الآخرون من مقارنتها بالنماذج الأخرى. وأخيرًا، انشر حزمة قابلة لإعادة الإنتاج: إصدار النموذج، وملفاتك الإضافية، وملفات الإعدادات والتشغيل الدفعي، والاستعلامات، وبرامج التحليل، وملف تعريفي قصير. فإن لم يستطع غيرك إعادة بناء أشكالك، فالدراسة لم تكتمل بعد.

tour.text: Name what GCAM transport cannot see, and how each limit could bias your result.
Make ethical choices visible: who travels, who pays, and reliance on future removals.
Describe GCAM properly and report in standard IAMC variables.
Ship a package that rebuilds every figure, so others can check your claims.

sections.heading: What GCAM transport cannot see
sections.html:
LimitWhy it mattersWhat you can do
No vehicle stock or countssales and fleet lag (Figure 3.15) are not explicit; "sales" is a proxyreport "service output by tech (new)" as a sales proxy; couple a stock model (RQ9)
Share-weights absorb what the costs missinfrastructure, preferences, regulation and data error sit in one numberreport share-weight paths as assumptions; test them (Figure 3.11)
Behaviour is a single representative travellerno income groups, early adopters or range anxietyadd disutility costs by consumer group (RQ10); compare with MESSAGEix-Transport
Freight has no value of timefreight mode shift responds to money cost onlytest the freight logit exponent; add rail speed explicitly
Aviation and shipping use generic liquidsa SAF or e-fuel mandate cannot be targeted without model changesadd a dedicated pass-through sector (RQ5); state the simplification
Regional parameters from 14 UCD regionsSaudi values are Middle East averages in core GCAMnational overrides or a country region (module 3.7)
Demand from income and price onlyurban form, telework, infrastructure and policy-driven demand reduction are outside the modelexogenous demand scenarios; low-demand sensitivities (Grubler et al. 2018 style)

sections.heading: Ethics: whose future, whose cost?
sections.html:
• Reliance on carbon removal. Net-zero transport in GCAM-KSA leans on direct air capture for aviation and shipping residuals (Qiu et al. 2024). Report gross and net emissions separately, and show a case with limited removal.
  • Distribution. A carbon price or fuel-price reform raises the cost of travel for households that cannot switch. GCAM's single representative consumer cannot show who pays; say so and point to studies that can.
  • Oil exporters. For Saudi Arabia, transport decarbonisation interacts with domestic fuel-price reform and export revenues; a cost-minimising pathway is not automatically a socially acceptable one.
  • Authority of numbers. A single scenario figure is easily quoted as a forecast. Show ranges, label scenarios by assumptions, and include "what the model cannot tell us" in the abstract, not only in the appendix.

sections.heading: Describing GCAM in a paper
sections.html:
JGCRI publishes suggested community guidelines for peer-reviewed articles that use GCAM (community-guide.html, checked 23 October 2026). In short:

GuidelineIn your paper
State the version"We use GCAM v9.1 (tag gcam-v9.1)" — never just "GCAM"
Describe the model in a short paragraphmultisector model developed at JGCRI, open source; 32 energy-economy regions, land in more than 300 subregions (396 in the guideline text), 235 water basins; cite JGCRI (2025), GCAM documentation v8.2, doi:10.5281/zenodo.15581183, plus model papers relevant to your sector
Data and code availabilitycite the public repository of the version used, with its DOI
Describe every modificationlist every departure from the public release; for substantial changes, rename the model with an identifier, e.g. "GCAM-<institution>" (as GCAM-KSA does)
Ask and collaboratequestions go to GCAM GitHub Discussions; JGCRI team members may be invited as co-authors

sections.heading: Reporting in the IAMC format
sections.html:
Report results in the IAMC template (model, scenario, region, variable, unit, then one column per year) with standard variable names, so they can be compared with the AR6 and CMIP7 scenario databases and read with pyam. Typical transport variables:

IAMC variableGCAM source
Energy Service|Transportation|Passenger (bn pkm/yr)transport service output by service (trn_pass)
Energy Service|Transportation|Freight (bn tkm/yr)transport service output by service (trn_freight)
Final Energy|Transportation|Electricity / Liquids / Hydrogen / Gases (EJ/yr)transport final energy by fuel
Emissions|CO2|Energy|Demand|Transportation (Mt CO2/yr)CO2 emissions by sector (excluding resource production)
Price|Carbon (US$2010/t CO2)CO2 prices (converted from 1990$/tC)

sections.heading: The reproducible package
sections.html: Publish (or archive with a DOI, e.g. on Zenodo) a package that lets a reader rebuild every figure: the GCAM version and commit; every add-on XML and configuration or batch file; any gcamdata modification chunk; the query file; the analysis scripts; the extracted results table; and a README with the run log (module 3.1). Large output databases do not need to be shared if the extracted table and the means to rebuild it are.

callouts.title: Why this matters
callouts.html: A net-zero transport pathway with 80 % zero-emission car sales can still leave aviation, shipping and heavy freight emitting tens of megatonnes a year, balanced by direct air capture that does not yet exist at scale. The model will report it as "net zero". Whether that is a plan or a gamble is not a question the model answers — and your paper has to say so.

callouts.title: Research note
callouts.html: Two numbers in the guideline. The community guideline says 396 land subregions, while the documentation overview says "more than 300" (the counts differ between pages and versions). Quote the number that matches your version's input files and say where it comes from.

callouts.title: Pitfall
callouts.html: "Results available on request." For a model that anyone can download, this is no longer acceptable to many journals or reviewers. If a reader cannot rebuild your scenarios from the paper and its archive, the scenarios are not reproducible — however carefully they were run.

callouts.title: Try it
callouts.html:
1. Write the two-sentence model description for a paper using GCAM v9.1 with a modified Middle East transport sector. What name would you give the modified model?
  2. List the five files a reviewer would need to rebuild your carbon-price scenario.
  3. Pick one limit from the first table that matters most for a Saudi ZEV-mandate study, and write the sentence you would put in the abstract about it.

takeaways: Name GCAM transport's blind spots and how they could bias your answer
Make the ethical choices in your scenarios visible
State the exact version and every change, following the GCAM community guidelines
Report in IAMC variables and publish a package that rebuilds every figure

quiz.q: Which of these can GCAM transport not report directly?
options: The number of vehicles on the road
quiz.explain: GCAM has no vehicle stock; a stock model is needed for fleets.

quiz.q: Why report in IAMC variable names?
options: So results can be compared with other models
quiz.explain: Standard names make results comparable across models and databases.

options: The GCAM version, add-ons, configuration, queries and scripts
quiz.explain: Everything needed for someone else to rebuild every figure.

quiz.q: An ethical choice hidden in many net-zero scenarios is…
options: Reliance on large carbon removal later in the century
quiz.explain: Heavy reliance on future removals shifts burden to later generations.
